rejected_rule.statement: A defendant in a partition suit must adduce proof of their title, as the duty of a judge to investigate title cannot be effectively discharged without adduction of some evidence towards proof of facta probanda.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In any event a District Court cannot embark on a wild goose chase or a voyage of discovery in the discharge of its task of fact finding if parties for bear to adduce evidence of the case they have placed before court - see Bandi Naide v Appu Naide {1923} 5 CL Recorder 192 for the proposition of double capacity of Plaintiff and Defendant.
